final_draft.answer: Our application's source repository is harborlight/app on GitHub. Changes to its default branch need two approving reviews before they can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators as well. GitHub secret scanning is switched on for harborlight/app.
final_draft.note: Redrafted so the answer names the repository, harborlight/app, at the start. The repository name was already in the previous draft. Both parts of the answer come from approved answers (valid until 2027-11-18, owner security@harborlight.example). A live check of harborlight/app on 2026-11-18 at 02:49 UTC agreed with both. Branch main was protected and needed 2 approving reviews, with the rule applying to administrators. Secret scanning was switched on. The checks covered only harborlight/app, not any other repositories.
